newsitem.title: TURKEY: Kurdish rebels kill two Turkish soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Kurdish rebels kill two Turkish soldiers.

text.p: Kurdish guerrillas have killed two Turkish soldiers in an ambush in heavy fighting in the eastern mountains, security officials said on Wednesday.
They said a group of around 50 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels attacked the soldiers near the town of Tunceli on Tuesday night.
Tens of thousands of troops, backed by air power, have been sweeping Tunceli in a spring offensive against the rebels since last weekend. Security officials say 43 rebels have been killed so far.
More than 22,000 people have died in the 12-year-old conflict between troops and the PKK, fighting for autonomy or independence.
